binding_contract: compiled source commit and exact image SHA256/bytes
successful full-flash readback/outside-approved-sectors-preserved installation receipt and normal-return receipt
exact HELLO build and fresh random protocol request identity after two matching boot handshakes
private exact selected device/port identity; never publish identifiers
helper source and complete dependency/expectation hashes, bounded scope grant
closed serial connection and protocol receipt; raw bytes remain private

endpoint_contract.acknowledgement_timings: ACCEPTED, CONSUMED and terminal response relative to same PRESS request audit timestamp
endpoint_contract.protocol_request_to_terminal_ms: 1000 * (matching terminal response audit.monotonic - PRESS request audit.monotonic); request trace is recorded immediately before host write, response trace when the full CRC-valid protocol line is decoded
endpoint_contract.request_identity: exact boot/session/request_id in all three replies; not retained in sanitized baseline
endpoint_contract.status_refresh_ms: Last completed firmware composition + blocking display/BUSY interval. May describe an earlier paint for NO_VISUAL_CHANGE; never reinterpret it as a new refresh
endpoint_contract.wrapper_completion_ms: 1000 * (action.finished - action.started); host monotonic immediately before client.request(PRESS), immediately after validated ordered three replies; excludes follow-up STATUS/DIAG

limits: Software serial completion includes host/USB/protocol scheduling and firmware dispatch/display work.
No independent button-to-optical endpoint, ghosting, physical waveform or battery-only claim.
Idle Home/Library DIAG unchanged fields are not a fresh full NVS read; subsequent actual Read verified exact saved selection/anchor.
The 20 navigation actions form existing baseline evidence; future journeys should reuse correctness actions for latency instead of adding an independent framework.
Navigation provenance uses execution-time bindings; its shared journey helper/expectation were later revised for the separate reader correctness run.

outcome_contract.capture: software framebuffer proof only; retained privately; not optical latency
outcome_contract.failure: Preserve failed/unknown request with partial acknowledgment evidence and stop; never automatic retry, never latency pass from a failed correctness action
outcome_contract.no_visual_change: retain separately; no generation advance/paint claim
outcome_contract.required: action/name, exact ordered replies, terminal outcome, post-action STATUS and DIAG screen/anchor/ownership checks, generations, refresh classification and all timing fields

refresh_contract.unknown: no unique classification, including missing or mixed tags; do not infer from screen, duration or refresh_ms
refresh_contract.window: telemetry received during matching PRESS request; existing raw driver/API tags

sample_contract.eligibility: completed, validated correctness actions from declared baseline run only; do not mix host fixture, build, reset, battery state or endpoints
sample_contract.goals: 500/750/1000ms goals are distinct from current sampled baseline ceilings; baseline does not imply goal met
sample_contract.method: sorted nearest rank ceil(p*n), no interpolation; retain n and individual samples
sample_contract.small_sample_limit: observed run only; n=1/2 groups have no distribution coverage
